Cheers,
Reuben

Happy to help. The excise form you need is the standard one we use for your filings — you can grab a fresh copy from the tax-return workflow playbook (it includes the current template reference), or I can send it directly if that's easier.

No worries on the timing — we've got this.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes
